desc: Model the operation as swapping gaps i and i+2, so odd/even gap classes can be permuted independently while the leftmost coordinate is fixed.
Derive the objective sum = N*x_1 + sum_{k=1}^{N-1} (N-k)*g_k and apply the rearrangement inequality separately to each parity class.
Implement the Python solution with integer arithmetic and O(N log N) sorting.
Validate samples and edge cases (N=4, large coordinates, equal gaps) and ensure output is an integer.
